ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  **Executive Summary:**  Acutaas Chemicals Limited has declared a final dividend of Rs. 2.50 per share for FY 2025-26, which, under the newly effective Income-tax Act, 2025, is now taxable at the shareholder's end requiring mandatory Tax Deducted at Source (TDS). Shareholders must proactively submit specific tax-related documents by September 15, 2026, to ensure application of the correct or lower withholding tax rates. Failure to do so will result in higher default TDS, placing a significant administrative burden and immediate financial impact on shareholders, particularly non-residents navigating complex Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) provisions, and potentially requiring them to claim refunds later.
